messages:
maria: Thanks everyone — quick thread to capture follow-ups from today's Security/Compliance segment. I'll log action items below, but please answer or ping if you need clarification.

leah: Appreciate the recap. I'll handle the audit/ISO questions, + will publish the evidence checklist next week.

jordan: Q1 — what's the ETA on the external ISO audit? Also who is owning the VPC/network diagram evidence?

leah: ISO external auditor visits targeted week of 2026-08-17 (tentative). We need the evidence package ready 2 weeks before. Infra (ashok) will own network diagrams; Security will own policy docs and risk register.

ashok: Confirmed — infra will produce updated VPC diagrams and peering/privatelink configs. Targeting first drafts by 2026-07-30.

jordan: Great — for the VPC diagrams, does the auditor want per-region configs or a single master diagram?

leah: They ask for both: a global architecture and region-specific snapshots for any region where customer data is stored. We'll provide a mapping doc.

eva: Quick product question: what's the default audit-log retention for hosted vs dedicated vs private? Need to communicate to customers.

ashok: Short answer: hosted default = 90 days. Dedicated can be extended via contract to up to 3 years. Private (VPC/on-prem) is customer-configurable; we recommend >=365 days for regulated customers. I'll add exact SLA language to the docs.

maria: @product_ops pls make sure pricing/legal has the add-on language for hosted retention extensions.

product_ops: Will do — linking to a draft PR once I have numbers.

jordan: KMS question: who rotates keys and what's the recommended cadence? Also what about emergency key unwrap/escrow?

leah: For Redwood-managed keys we rotate every 90 days by policy. BYOK customers are responsible for rotation; we support automated rotation workflows via our KMS integration. Emergency unwrap requires a 4-eyes approval: CISO + engineering lead sign-off, and we log the event. Expect ~48h turnaround for non-critical requests.

samir: I'll add a short runbook for emergency unwraps and include the audit log checks. Draft snippet for evidence queries below.

samir: ```bash
# example: fetch audit events for key unwraps (pseudo)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/audit?event=key_unwrap&start=2026-07-01&end=2026-07-30"
```

leah: Nice. Also: we maintain a retention index on unwrap events and key rotation metadata; auditors will want hashes/timestamps for the chain of custody.

ashok: Regarding cross-region log replication: for Dedicated/Private we can configure async replication to a customer-specified S3/GCS destination. For hosted customers, we replicate within the region and can push exports on request (add-on).

jordan: One customer asked if we can support 3-year retention for audit logs on Hosted API for a regulated workload — is that doable?

ashok: Possible as a paid add-on under contract. We'll need to scope storage, egress, and support SLAs. Please route requests to solutions-eng and I'll pick up the technical sizing.

leah: A note on BYOK: when customers provide keys, we do not persist plaintext keys. We store wrapped key material and metadata. Rotation procedures are documented; customers can opt into our rotation orchestration or manage keys themselves.

maria: Can someone own publishing a short FAQ for customers (1-pager) covering: retention tiers, KMS rotation options, emergency unwrap process, and contact flow?

product_ops: I can own the customer-facing FAQ. Samir/leah/ashok — can you provide bullet points by EOD 2026-07-05?

samir: I can provide the security bullets.

ashok: Infra bullets coming, will include timing and technical constraints.

leah: Security bullets and the approvals table coming from me.

maria: Final: action items and owners — 1) Evidence checklist for ISO (leah) due 2026-07-10. 2) VPC diagrams (ashok) due 2026-07-30. 3) Customer FAQ (product_ops) due 2026-07-08. 4) Emergency unwrap runbook (samir) due 2026-07-06. Reply here if you need different dates.

security-bot: Reminder set for leah (2026-07-10) and for ashok (2026-07-30).

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll keep the all-hands notes updated and escalate any blocker. :thumbsup:
